name: 33197-lorabatchdecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, no expert parallelism (FusedMoEWithLoRA asserts not use_ep), fully_sharded_loras off (the default).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=4, bounded at 120 requests with an 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion, which left 107 in the measured window as run. Four in flight is the operating point, not a low-load accident -- see `workload`.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, no tools: fixed-shape random-token requests, 1580 prompt tokens and exactly 600 output tokens, both pinned min=max and the output exact (`max_tokens=600` with `ignore_eos=True`). `request_format: plain`, so no chat template is applied and the wire prompt is the declared 1580. Greedy (temperature 0.0). 600 output tokens against 1580 prompt tokens makes the run overwhelmingly decode steps, which is where the four-request batch this setup fixes actually lives.
purpose: A long-form drafting assistant with LoRA adapters on one GPU, serving four concurrent users long completions.
launch:
# Launch config for 33197-lorabatchdecode-qwen3moe30b-1gpu: one H100 serving a 128-expert
# sparse-MoE model with the MoE-LoRA path switched on, four requests in flight. Every key here
# goes into AsyncEngineArgs (dashes become underscores); the adapter itself cannot be named
# here, because `--lora-modules` is an API-server argument and this item runs the engine
# in process.
model: Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
enable-lora: true
# One adapter slot. This is an ordinary serving choice, not the answer: the sibling item
# 33848 openly serves the same model at `max-loras: 8`. It is declared because the stacked
# per-expert MoE-LoRA buffers are sized from it, so a reader cannot reconstruct the served
# configuration without it.
max-loras: 1
max-lora-rank: 8
max-num-seqs: 16
enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
